div.head: ECf retr Rb XLV

ab.hi: Descriptio genealogie ducum Normannorum á Ról
Henricum† Anglie; et qua auctoritate quaue ratione sanctus rex Edwardus

div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 672 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page; the words in bold are the Retractator’s changes to ECf, as Liebermann prints them.

This is one of the chapter headings (rubrics) that a later writer, whom Liebermann calls “Rubricator II” and dates 1163–1189, made for the Retractator’s text; so the date given for ECf retr (c. 1140–59) does not apply to it. Liebermann prints them on pp. 670–672 as an appendix (Anhang) to ECf retr; they are numbered here “Rb” with his Roman numerals. He prints in small type what is taken from the text of ECf retr, so the words in bold are the Rubricator’s own.

This heading belongs not to ECf retr but to the Genealogia Normannorum that follows it in the manuscripts (Liebermann’s note b); it is all in bold, as the Rubricator’s own. Liebermann puts note b on the numeral; here it stands at the start of the heading.
The dagger after “Henricum” refers to Liebermann’s marginal date †1154–89 (Henry II).

div.ab: Description of the genealogy of the dukes of the Normans from Rollo (Ról), the first duke, to the second King Henry† of England; and by what authority and for what reason the holy King Edward appointed Duke William heir.
